method: Fresh ConvNeXt-V2 Base; stage-wise AdamW/cosine; fixed raw-versus-EMA selection
pretrained_weights: official FCMAE pretrained, ImageNet-22K then ImageNet-1K fine-tuned 224px EMA weights
attention: none_added; native ConvNeXt-V2 Global Response Normalization retained
preprocessing: PIL RGB; direct 224x224 bicubic resize preserving the entire image; ToTensor; ImageNet mean/std; no evaluation crop
augmentation: train only: independent horizontal/vertical flips0.5; uniform quarter-turn k in0,1,2,3; same resize and normalization
imbalance: train-only square-root inverse-frequency weights normalized to mean1; no oversampling or double compensation
loss: weighted_cross_entropy_from_fp32_logits; numerator summed over effective batch divided by its target-weight sum
notes: Fresh author external weights; original exploratory split with natural train/validation lesion overlap. No R202 initialization, CBAM, test inference or automatic ensemble. 30 planned epochs; meaningful counters observational; manual stop honored at committed epoch. Two predeclared branches, raw and fixed EMA0.999; earliest maximum accuracy, raw at same-epoch ties. CPU closeout verified eight checkpoints, nine prediction packages and full curves/class/confusion artifacts. R204 addition and R205 replacement lower S83 accuracy; training closed, no extension or test evaluation.
